resources.string: Reads screen content and performs UI actions for the Agentic OS assistant. Allows the assistant to open apps, type messages, and automate tasks.
Needed to send and read SMS messages for auto-reply and messaging commands.
Needed to make phone calls and read call logs for missed call automation.
Needed to access contacts for messaging and calling by name.
Needed for voice commands and speech recognition.
Needed for potential future features (QR scanning, etc.).
Needed to show assistant responses and status.
Needed to read calendar events for scheduling.
Needed to read media files and control playback.
Enable in Settings → Accessibility → Agentic OS Screen Reader. Allows the assistant to read your screen and tap buttons.
Enable in Settings → Notifications → Notification Access → Agentic OS. Allows auto-reply to missed calls and reading notifications.
Enable in Settings → Digital Wellbeing → Usage Access → Agentic OS. Allows learning your patterns for smart automations.
Enable in Settings → Apps → Special Access → Display over other apps → Agentic OS. Allows floating microphone button.
Your personal phone assistant that runs entirely on-device. No cloud required for core features.
Send texts, make calls, read messages, and auto-reply to missed calls.
Automate actions when you arrive at work, leave home, or enter geofences.
Play music, backup photos automatically, and control media playback.
Set alarms, toggle WiFi/Bluetooth, get notifications, and use voice commands.
Required for screen reading, auto-reply, and notification monitoring.
Agentic OS is ready. Tap the mic button or say "Hey Agent" to start.
